seo.title: Refund and return policy
seo.description: Refund and return policy for services and digital products from arafatbin.com.

hero.title: Refund and return policy
hero.subtitle: When you can get your money back.

sections.heading: 1. Services
paragraphs: If I cannot deliver the agreed work, you get a full refund. Once work has started, a partial refund may be given based on the work already done.

sections.heading: 2. Digital products
paragraphs: Digital products such as templates cannot be returned after the files are sent. If a file is broken or not as described, I will fix it, replace it or refund you.

sections.heading: 3. Fiverr orders
paragraphs: Orders placed on Fiverr follow Fiverr's own refund and cancellation rules.

sections.heading: 4. How to ask for a refund
list: Email contact@arafatbin.com or message me on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery
Include your order details and the reason
Approved refunds are sent within 7 working days, using the original payment method where possible
